headline: Biman resumes Sylhet–Manchester flights after four-month suspension
summary: The first flight carrying 272 passengers landed at Osmani International Airport on Sunday, marking the return of the direct service.
details: The direct flight service between Manchester and Sylhet has resumed after a four-month suspension. The first flight landed at Sylhet Osmani International Airport on Sunday at 12 PM, carrying 272 passengers.
Passengers were welcomed with flowers by Civil Aviation and Tourism Minister Afroza Khanam Rita, Commerce Minister Khandaker Abdul Muqtadir, and Prime Minister's Advisor Humayun Kabir.
During a press briefing, the ministers stated that the government is working to increase facilities for expatriates.
They also assured that necessary steps are being taken to improve Biman's service quality and to launch a new flight route between Sylhet and Cox's Bazar.
caption:
Direct flights between Manchester and Sylhet are back! After four months, 272 passengers landed in Sylhet on Sunday.

The direct flight service between Manchester and Sylhet has resumed after a four-month suspension. The first flight landed at Sylhet Osmani International Airport on Sunday at 12 PM, carrying 272 passengers.

Passengers were welcomed with flowers by Civil Aviation and Tourism Minister Afroza Khanam Rita, Commerce Minister Khandaker Abdul Muqtadir, and Prime Minister's Advisor Humayun Kabir.

During a press briefing, the ministers stated that the government is working to increase facilities for expatriates.

They also assured that necessary steps are being taken to improve Biman's service quality and to launch a new flight route between Sylhet and Cox's Bazar.

#Bangladesh #Biman #Sylhet #Manchester #Aviation #Travel

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Somoy News

headline_marked: Man [[beaten to death over theft suspicion]] in Chattogram
headline: Man beaten to death over theft suspicion in Chattogram
summary: A 32-year-old man was killed by a mob after locals tracked a stolen mobile phone to his location using Google's 'Find My Device'.
details: A 32-year-old man, identified as Md Belal, was beaten to death on suspicion of theft in Hathazari, Chattogram, yesterday.
According to police, locals caught Belal after tracking a stolen mobile phone using Google's 'Find My Device' feature.
The victim was reportedly tied to a pole and severely beaten while it was raining.
As his condition worsened, he was taken to Hathazari Upazila Health Complex, where doctors declared him dead.
Kazi Tarek Aziz, additional superintendent of police (Hathazari circle), confirmed the details of the incident to the press.
caption:
Tracked by 'Find My Device', a man was beaten to death by a mob in Chattogram over theft suspicions.

A 32-year-old man, identified as Md Belal, was beaten to death on suspicion of theft in Hathazari, Chattogram, yesterday.

According to police, locals caught Belal after tracking a stolen mobile phone using Google's 'Find My Device' feature.

The victim was reportedly tied to a pole and severely beaten while it was raining.

As his condition worsened, he was taken to Hathazari Upazila Health Complex, where doctors declared him dead.

Kazi Tarek Aziz, additional superintendent of police (Hathazari circle), confirmed the details of the incident to the press.
